software.c_index: train_dann_survival.harrell_c_index (Harrell concordance, higher risk = shorter survival)
software.cox: lifelines.CoxPHFitter (penalizer=0.01), Harrell C-index on partial hazard linear predictor
software.reference_implementation: biolearn (bio-learn/biolearn) for Horvath transform and GrimAge V2 pipeline

aesurv_log_h.description: Frozen DANN encoder + AESurv Cox head on JL-projected methylation+SNP features. Primary training target: survival (time, event). Auxiliary age loss during training (aux_age_weight) but chronological age is NOT an input at inference.

Horvath.scoring: linear_predictor = intercept + sum(beta_cpg * coef_cpg); age_years = anti_trafo(linear_predictor + 0.696)

PhenoAge.scoring: age_years = intercept + sum(beta_cpg * coef_cpg)  [no Gompertz transform]

DunedinPACE.scoring: pace = intercept + sum(beta_cpg * coef_cpg); note: biolearn applies Gold-standard QN preprocess (not applied here)

GrimAge.scoring: Per-component linear DNAm scores + COX linear combination with Age and Female; DNAmGrimAge = ((COX - m_cox)/sd_cox)*sd_age + m_age (biolearn GrimageModel)

EpiClock.training_supervision: chronological_age (same paradigm as Horvath elastic-net on methylation)

AESurv_log_h.scoring: log_h from frozen multi-omic model (methylation + SNP, no age input at inference)
AESurv_log_h.auxiliary_training: age reconstruction loss (not used at prediction)

derived_metrics.GrimAge_accel: GrimAge - chronological_age (approx.; biolearn uses regression residual)

cindex_evaluation.risk_direction: higher score = higher mortality risk (shorter survival)

FHS.split: train_test_split test_size=0.15 stratified on event, random_state=42

incremental_cox.lrt: likelihood ratio test nested models vs M0
